LanguageData.MegaMod_RedAlert_Activated: Red Alert ACTIVATED! Non-violent colonists and animals have retreated to the shelter; combatants have been auto-drafted.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RedAlert_Deactivated: Red Alert DEACTIVATED. Area restrictions have been restored and colonists undrafted.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RedAlert_TooltipActive: Red Alert is ACTIVE! Colony is in emergency defense mode. Click or press hotkey to stand down.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RedAlert_TooltipInactive: Red Alert is inactive. Click or press hotkey to mobilize emergency defense protocol.
